result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the best overall CRM. It's relatively easy to learn, has a useful free version, and gives you room to grow without immediately needing a complicated system.

However, the best choice depends on how your team manages customers and sales.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free option available for up to 2 users.
- Contact management, sales pipeline, email tracking.
- Marketing and customer service integrations.
- Easy for new teams to adopt.

Best for: Small businesses wanting an all-around solution.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![30MPC Masterclass | Pipedrive](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YXtK01sDnPYRmrgl-cq3FoFz_gi03_11mtWIHg1kzW5LP-eLYfON-4AW8Be22mb410EXqHg1l_NK3GQkL0OnZs_wo-cAhYHW7JLl_VjWui99Y_oYNiabMsX1QWg6He98qMA1qCh9iTsRxLcxXEYyZcd4w83XvE6jKhETG-afSiGIXEQdSFY0k5LqqYHz7Qmi?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks leads, deals and follow-ups.
- Easy to see what every salesperson is working on.
- Paid plans start around \$14/user/month annually.

Best for: Teams focused on closing deals and managing prospects.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![Systemy CRM przykłady dostępnych na rynku](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ozMKHOYgPNfTodqTy1-KuVP1BizKKwV3DxjmrLeH0xvcXQhJ5tVhP4VMMyJczdNuqh3Ft03_r89Z0P8-xNGaL4RX9OpJOBUAIEnC_fB03hMcujhg2ceKlJF93NeMPkhu7eb5fgJK2TTEETAI6NrVPxoPMqY0QeuibcH6sMr3VU0hzlJzfPFgfFss2Oq2HIS3?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best budget option)

- Free plan for up to 3 users.
- Strong automation and customization.
- Lots of integrations with other business tools.
- Paid plans start around \$14/user/month annually.

Best for: Businesses wanting lots of features without spending much.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales – AI-Powered CRM for Efficient Sales & Customer Management – Daidu.ai](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/y7Vb4xAcRAAEuqjagQXpFAF7AnuXMUElBxy4BgPXr8eZYF7Dkte6UvmlzH7N7Gng8CLjCWbvU78ky87jsrjvYxdASFZf0fX5TJAm3axZjmliiRYYmBFh9H4s49unQfi71zpX0ByRdXwVVL50YsRCn7JH7nOSk0tgkqnFMggeUC_Qb730HNfnItPlsuAKqMt-?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Free plan for up to 3 users.
- Built-in phone, email and chat capabilities.
- Sales automation and lead management.
- Paid plans start around \$9/user/month annually.

Best for: Teams that communicate with lots of prospects.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![Less Annoying CRM Price, Reviews & Ratings - Capterra Israel 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/h5HSiVNRwVjN3WTogZWMhibp5qMMlPdfs4JRFv5ZYEPQI3pePfh7dBwinr24e60rkgMH4IyS-A0iCoYdyIvEd7hBa-8J8u67qPPaYZKRKXrTzSgziypbv-dhvNtSm5_KIK9_EV_zE9cHaInZmZHhXAAZjs9-wTdgGcoQjV7JeuowKHIDZ3Y5Zb3Mh9C4AMT0?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

- Very simple interface.
- Easy contact and lead management.
- Minimal learning curve.
- Around \$15/user/month.

Best for: Small teams that don't want complicated software.

[Explore Less Annoying CRM](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)
